metrics_and_k.rationale: User-approved candidate decision: ANN–exact metrics use K=10. Quality metrics and their K values remain non-applicable while absolute relevance is disabled.

ann_exact.criterion: For every query, ExactTopKRecall@10 and OrderedTopKMatch@10 must each equal exactly 1.0.

acceptance_rules_and_tolerances.rationale: User-approved candidate decision: both ANN–exact metrics must equal 1.0 for each query; no retrospective tie-breaking is permitted.

value.aggregation: Retain and report each query result; macro-average may be shown for descriptive summary only and does not determine the gate.
value.tie_policy: Use the ranking as observed; do not apply retrospective tie-breaking.
value.undefined_policy: Any required undefined metric blocks PASS.

run_count_and_aggregation.rationale: User-approved candidate decisions: one run, per-query reporting, descriptive-only macro-average, observed ties without retrospective resolution, and fail-closed handling of required undefined metrics.

corpus_and_query_candidate_scope.rationale: Corpus candidate is an unreviewed draft; owner review, exact scope approval, and freeze remain unresolved.

labels_rubric_and_adjudication.rationale: Absolute relevance is disabled; any future labels, rubric, and adjudication remain unresolved and are not applicable to this candidate gate.

ann_exact_comparison_scope.rationale: Retrieval path and candidate scope require owner review and explicit protocol-run approval.

encoder_identity.rationale: Encoder identity is unresolved; no identity or runtime evidence is asserted.

provenance.rationale: Operational provenance is unresolved; no provenance evidence or run authorization is asserted.
